source: PROPOSAL.md, DATASET_REGISTER_2026-09-08.md; status derived from results/ tree
standing_rule: RULER NIAH n=60 is the primary RQ2 cohort. Any added dataset (BABILong / NoLiMa / SCROLLS) is exploratory unless a pre-run amendment defines its role, metric, size and decision rule.

cohorts.composition: niah_single_1, 7-digit answers; ~32 evicted / ~28 in-window at the 8064 window (needle depth is random)
cohorts.metric: mean digit rank of the answer sequence in the J-lens readout; substring accuracy for the behavioural floor

cohorts.n: 10 needles x 7 eviction distances x 3 filler variants
cohorts.role: Supporting / limitations analysis (under-reads L27 vs RULER)

cohorts.composition: length-stratified: 20 short / 20 mid / 20 long; eligible prompts only (> window + sinks, <= 32000 tokens)
cohorts.role: RQ1 behavioural effect (AHN vs NOWRITE), first-line scoring
cohorts.metric: QA F1 per example; answer-change rate; per-example boundary JS

cohorts.composition: gold-answer first-token rank at layers 9/18/27 joined to delta_f1
cohorts.role: RQ3 headline: rho(retention half-life, delta_f1) vs rho(JS, F1) ~ 0
cohorts.metric: Spearman rho, Holm-corrected across layers, bootstrap CI

cohorts.n: 2 x 1000 contexts (disjoint halves; skip 0 vs skip 20000)
cohorts.composition: generic English, strictly disjoint from RULER / LongBench / LV-Eval
cohorts.role: Table 3 map fit + map-stability check (r17, 1000-context refit)
cohorts.metric: top-10 token overlap between the two disjoint-corpus maps

cohorts.composition: single-token answers with a leading space
cohorts.metric: rank of the answer token from ~layer 20

cohorts.role: Limitations: needle-identity / category-dependent retention at L18/L27
cohorts.metric: needle-level mean rank, two-sample permutation test, Holm-corrected
